description: This file defines the 'Rule' interface in the org.openmrs.logic package, which serves as a base for all logic rule implementations in the OpenMRS system. It declares methods for evaluating rules, retrieving parameters, dependencies, TTL, and datatype details.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Interface that all logic rules must implement, providing methods for evaluation, parameter retrieval, dependency analysis, TTL, and datatype management.

methods.name: getParameterList
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters required or used by the rule.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an array of tokens representing rules or data sources that this rule depends on.

methods.name: getTTL
methods.description: Returns the time in seconds during which the rule's result is considered valid.

methods.name: getDefaultDatatype
methods.description: Returns the default data type that the rule outputs.
